ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Used to create #anchor-links on the page. Letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

SectionEyebrow.helper: Optional. Small label shown above the section heading.

SectionHeading.helper: Required. Centered heading shown above the cards. Formatted text and links are allowed.

IntroText.helper: Optional. Supporting copy shown below the heading. Formatted text and links are allowed.
IntroText.placeholder: Explore adjacent evaluation paths that connect mission data, geospatial workflows, network analysis, and deployable compute.

CentralLogoType.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

CentralIconClass.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

CentralLogoImage.helper: Image used in the center when Central Logo Type is Image. For this site, use the Portexa logo image.

CentralLogoAltText.helper: Accessible alt text for the center image. Falls back to the module or section label when empty.

Cards.helper: Add one to four cards. The editor allows up to four cards.

Eyebrow.helper: Optional. Small category label shown above the card title.

Description.helper: Optional. Card body copy. Formatted text and links are allowed.
Description.placeholder: Coordinate command, control, communications, computers, intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance workflows.

Link.helper: Optional. When set, the full card renders as a clickable link.

OpenInNewWindow.helper: Open the card link in a new browser tab.

OrbitItems.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

Label.helper: Enter the text visitors should see for this link.

IconClass.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

IconColor.helper: Choose the icon color from the available options.

OrbitNumber.helper: Choose which dotted orbit ring should contain this item.
